#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Get parent directory to create the archive outside the current directory
PARENT_DIR=$(dirname "$PWD")

# Generate timestamp for the archive name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -C "$PARENT_DIR" \
    "$DIR_NAME"

echo "✓ Archive created: ${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "  Size: $(du -h "${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to print colored output
print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗ $1${NC}"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ $1${NC}"
}

print_info() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}→ $1${NC}"
}

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables from .env.test
validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Pre-deployment Validation"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        print_error "Environment file '$env_file' not found!"
        echo ""
        echo "Please create a .env.test file with your required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    print_info "Reading environment variables from $env_file..."
    echo ""

    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract key and value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            ((total_vars++))

            # Check if the environment variable is set and non-empty
            if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
                missing_vars+=("$key")
                print_error "$key - NOT SET"
            elif [[ -z "$(echo "${!key}" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]]; then
                empty_vars+=("$key")
                print_error "$key - EMPTY"
            else
                print_success "$key - OK"
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="

    # Report results
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 || ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        print_error "Validation FAILED!"
        echo ""
        echo "Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}" "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set the required environment variables and try again."
        exit 1
    fi

    print_success "All $total_vars environment variables validated successfully!"
    echo ""
}

# Run validation
validate_env

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Get parent directory to create the archive outside the current directory
PARENT_DIR=$(dirname "$PWD")

# Generate timestamp for the archive name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "=========================================="
echo "Creating Release Archive"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

print_info "Creating tar.gz archive..."

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -C "$PARENT_DIR" \
    "$DIR_NAME"

echo ""
print_success "Archive created: ${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "  Size: $(du -h "${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
echo ""
echo "=========================================="
print_success "Deployment package ready!"
echo "=========================================="

NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Deployment orchestrator endpoint
DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Function to print colored output
print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗ $1${NC}"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ $1${NC}"
}

    echo -e "${YELLOW}→ $1${NC}"
}

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables from .env.test

    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()

    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        print_error "Environment file '$env_file' not found!"
        echo ""
        echo "Please create a .env.test file with your required environment variables."
        exit 1

        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract key and value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            ((total_vars++))

            # Check if the environment variable is set and non-empty
            if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then

                print_error "$key - NOT SET"

                print_error "$key - EMPTY"
            else
                print_success "$key - OK"
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="

    # Report results
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 || ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        print_error "Validation FAILED!"
        echo ""

        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set the required environment variables and try again."
        exit 1
    fi

    print_success "All $total_vars environment variables validated successfully!"
    echo ""
}

# Send config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_deploy_config() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local json_body="{"
    local first=true

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Deployment Orchestrator - Audit Log"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    print_info "Preparing config payload from $env_file..."

    # Build JSON object from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract key and value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${!key}"  # Use the actual environment variable value

            # Escape special characters in value for JSON
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')

            # Add comma separator if not first entry
            if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
                first=false
            else
                json_body+=","
            fi

            json_body+="\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    json_body+="}"

    print_info "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."
    echo ""

    # POST to deployment orchestrator
    http_response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_body" \
        "$DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL" 2>&1)

    # Extract HTTP status code and response body
    http_code=$(echo "$http_response" | tail -n 1)
    response_body=$(echo "$http_response" | sed '$d')

    # Check if curl succeeded
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        print_error "Failed to connect to deployment orchestrator at $DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL"
        echo ""
        echo "Please ensure the deployment orchestrator service is running."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check HTTP response code
    if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
        print_success "Config successfully sent to deployment orchestrator"
        echo "  Response: $response_body"
        echo ""
    else
        print_error "Failed to send config (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "  Response: $response_body"
        echo ""
        echo "Cannot proceed with deployment without audit compliance."
        exit 1
    fi
}

validate_env

send_deploy_config

}

validate_env_variables() {
    local env_test_file="$SCRIPT_DIR/.env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0

    echo ""
    print_status "==========================================" "$YELLOW"
    print_status "Pre-deployment Validation" "$YELLOW"
    print_status "==========================================" "$YELLOW"

    tar -czvf "$OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME" \

        print_status "  File: $OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME" "$GREEN"
        print_status "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE" "$GREEN"
        print_status "==========================================" "$GREEN"
    else
        print_status "✗ Error: Failed to create archive" "$RED"
        exit 1
    fi
}

    print_status "Deployment Script" "$YELLOW"

    if [ ! -f "$env_test_file" ]; then
        print_status "⚠ Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping config submission" "$YELLOW"
        return 0
    fi

    # Build JSON object from .env.test file
    # Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2",...}
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

        [ -z "$key" ] && continue

        # Get the actual value from environment (for audit, we send the resolved values)
        actual_value="${!key}"

        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        # Escape backslashes first, then double quotes, then control characters
        escaped_value=$(echo "$actual_value" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' -e 's/\t/\\t/g' -e 's/\r/\\r/g' -e 's/\n/\\n/g')

        # Add comma separator if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload+=","
        fi

        json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < "$env_test_file"

    # Add metadata to the payload
    local full_payload=$(cat <<EOF

  "project": "$PROJECT_NAME",
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "config": $json_payload
}
EOF
)

        print_status "  Response: $response_body" "$RED"
        echo ""

validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0
    
    echo -e "${YELLOW}=== Pre-deployment Validation ===${NC}"
    echo "Checking environment variables from: ${env_file}"
    echo ""

        exit 1

        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key (everything before =)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | xargs)

            continue

            echo -e "  ${YELLOW}⚠${NC} ${key} - ${YELLOW}set but empty${NC}"
        else
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${NC} ${key} - set"
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo ""
    echo "Total variables checked: ${total_vars}"

    # Report any issues

        if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo -e "  Missing variables: ${RED}${missing_vars[*]}${NC}"

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory (tar.gz)
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# -c: create archive
# -f: specify filename

    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -czf "$PARENT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME" \

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory (tar.gz)
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PARENT_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
DIR_NAME="$(basename "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# ============================================
# Pre-deployment Validation
# ============================================

validate_env_variables() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Validating environment variables...${NC}"
    
    local env_path="$SCRIPT_DIR/$ENV_FILE"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_path" ]]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Error: $ENV_FILE not found at $env_path${NC}"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name (everything before =)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            ((total_vars++))
            
            # Check if the variable is set in the environment
            if [[ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]]; then
                missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            elif [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
                empty_vars+=("$var_name")
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_path"
    
    # Report results
    echo "Checked $total_vars variables from $ENV_FILE"
    
    # Exit if there are missing or empty variables
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Missing environment variables:${NC}"
        printf '  - %s\n' "${missing_vars[@]}"
    fi
    
    if [[ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Empty environment variables:${NC}"
        printf '  - %s\n' "${empty_vars[@]}"
    fi
    
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 || ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Pre-deployment validation failed!${NC}"
        echo "Please set all required environment variables before deploying."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All required environment variables are set${NC}"
    echo ""
}

# ============================================
# Send Config to Deployment Orchestrator
# ============================================

send_deploy_config() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator...${NC}"
    
    local env_path="$SCRIPT_DIR/$ENV_FILE"
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true
    
    # Read .env.test and build JSON payload with resolved values
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name and value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            # Use the resolved value from environment
            var_value="${!var_name}"
            
            # Escape special characters in value for JSON
            var_value="${var_value//\\/\\\\}"
            var_value="${var_value//\"/\\\"}"
            var_value="${var_value//$'\n'/\\n}"
            var_value="${var_value//$'\r'/\\r}"
            var_value="${var_value//$'\t'/\\t}"
            
            if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
                first=false
            else
                json_payload+=","
            fi
            
            json_payload+="\"${var_name}\":\"${var_value}\""
        fi
    done < "$env_path"
    
    json_payload+="}"
    
    # POST to deployment orchestrator
    http_code=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/deploy_config_response.txt \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL")
    
    if [[ "$http_code" -ge 200 && "$http_code" -lt 300 ]]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Config successfully sent to deployment orchestrator${NC}"
        echo "Response code: $http_code"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator${NC}"
        echo "HTTP Status: $http_code"
        if [[ -f /tmp/deploy_config_response.txt ]]; then
            echo "Response: $(cat /tmp/deploy_config_response.txt)"
        fi
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo ""
}

# Run validation
validate_env_variables

# Send config for audit compliance
send_deploy_config

# ============================================
# Create Release Archive
# ============================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}Creating release archive...${NC}"
echo "Source directory: $SCRIPT_DIR"
echo "Archive name: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create the archive
# --exclude-vcs: excludes .git and other version control directories
# --exclude: explicitly exclude node_modules
# -z: compress with gzip
# -c: create archive

tar \
    --exclude-vcs \

    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \

ENV_FILE=".env.test"
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Declare arrays to store config (used by multiple functions)
declare -A ENV_CONFIG

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Pre-deployment Validation"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "⚠ Warning: ${env_file} file not found."
        echo "  Skipping environment variable validation."
        echo ""
        return 0
    fi

    echo "Reading environment variables from: ${env_file}"
    echo ""

    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract key and value (format: KEY=value or KEY=)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then

            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            ((total_vars++))

            # Check if the environment variable is set
            if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then

            elif [[ -z "${!key// /}" ]]; then
                empty_vars+=("$key")
                echo "  ✗ $key - EMPTY"
            else
                echo "  ✓ $key - OK"
                # Store the actual environment value for orchestrator
                ENV_CONFIG["$key"]="${!key}"
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    echo ""
    echo "------------------------------------------"
    echo "Validation Summary:"
    echo "  Total variables checked: $total_vars"
    echo "  Missing: ${#missing_vars[@]}"
    echo "  Empty: ${#empty_vars[@]}"
    echo "------------------------------------------"

    # Fail if any variables are missing or empty
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 || ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then

    fi

    echo "✓ All environment variables validated successfully!"
    echo ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local url="$1"

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Deployment Orchestrator - Audit Submission"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    # Check if we have any config to send
    if [[ ${#ENV_CONFIG[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "⚠ Warning: No environment configuration to send."
        echo "  Skipping orchestrator notification."
        echo ""
        return 0
    fi

    echo "Sending deployment config to: ${url}"
    echo ""

    # Build JSON from the ENV_CONFIG associative array
    local json="{"
    local first=true

    for key in "${!ENV_CONFIG[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi
        # Escape quotes and backslashes in values for valid JSON
        local value="${ENV_CONFIG[$key]}"
        value="${value//\\/\\\\}"      # Escape backslashes

        json+="\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
    done

    json+="}"

    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    local http_code
    local response

    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "Payload: ${json}"
        echo ""

        http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "${json}" \
            "${url}" 2>&1) || {
            echo "✗ Failed to connect to deployment orchestrator!"
            echo "  URL: ${url}"
            echo "  Error: Connection refused or timeout"
            echo ""
            exit 1
        }

        if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
            echo "✓ Config successfully sent to orchestrator"
            echo "  HTTP Status: ${http_code}"
            echo "  Timestamp: ${TIMESTAMP}"
            echo ""
        else
            echo "✗ Orchestrator returned error!"
            echo "  HTTP Status: ${http_code}"
            echo "  URL: ${url}"
            echo ""
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "✗ Error: curl is required but not installed."
        echo "  Please install curl to use the orchestrator integration."
        echo ""
        exit 1
    fi
}

send_config_to_orchestrator "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude="${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory (tar.gz)
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${YELLOW}Creating release archive...${NC}"
echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo ""

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    -C "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")" \
    "$PROJECT_NAME"

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Archive created successfully!${NC}"
    echo "Location: $SCRIPT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
else

validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0

    echo -e "${YELLOW}Validating environment variables from $env_file...${NC}"
    echo ""

        [ -z "$key" ] && continue

            echo ""
        fi

        echo "Please set the required environment variables and try again."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All $total_vars required environment variables are set${NC}"
    echo ""

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file="$1"

    echo -e "${YELLOW}Sending deployment config to orchestrator...${NC}"
    echo ""

    # Build JSON from .env.test file
    local json="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments

        # Extract key and value

        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2- | xargs)

        # Skip if no key
        [ -z "$key" ] && continue

        # Escape special characters in key and value for JSON
        key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

        # Add comma if not first entry
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi

        json+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"

    json+="}"

    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
    http_response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json" \
        "$DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL")

    # Extract HTTP status code and response body
    http_code=$(echo "$http_response" | tail -n 1)
    response_body=$(echo "$http_response" | sed '$d')

    # Check if request was successful
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Deployment config sent successfully${NC}"
        echo "  URL: $DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL"
        echo "  Status: $http_code"
        if [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $response_body"
        fi
        echo ""
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to send deployment config${NC}"
        echo "  URL: $DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL"
        echo "  Status: $http_code"
        if [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $response_body"
        fi
        echo ""
        echo "Cannot proceed with deployment. Please check orchestrator service."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# ============================================
# Send Config to Deployment Orchestrator
# ============================================

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file="$1"

    echo -e "${YELLOW}Sending deployment config to orchestrator...${NC}"
    echo ""

    # Build JSON from .env.test file
    local json="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2- | xargs)

        # Skip if no key
        [ -z "$key" ] && continue

        # Escape special characters in key and value for JSON
        key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

        # Add comma if not first entry
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi

        json+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"

    json+="}"

    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
    http_response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json" \
        "$DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL")

    # Extract HTTP status code and response body
    http_code=$(echo "$http_response" | tail -n 1)
    response_body=$(echo "$http_response" | sed '$d')

    # Check if request was successful
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Deployment config sent successfully${NC}"
        echo "  URL: $DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL"
        echo "  Status: $http_code"
        if [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $response_body"
        fi
        echo ""
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to send deployment config${NC}"
        echo "  URL: $DEPLOY_CONFIG_URL"
        echo "  Status: $http_code"
        if [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $response_body"
        fi
        echo ""
        echo "Cannot proceed with deployment. Please check orchestrator service."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Run validation

# Send config to orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator "$ENV_TEST_FILE"

echo -e "${YELLOW}Creating release archive...${NC}"
echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    -C "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")" \
    "$PROJECT_NAME"

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Archive created successfully!${NC}"
    echo "Location: $SCRIPT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to create archive${NC}"
    exit 1
fi
